LIB CONNECT TO [Databricks];
LOAD [DateKey] AS [DateKey],
	[Date] AS [Date],
	[Day] AS [Day],
	[Month] AS [Month],
	[MonthName] AS [MonthName],
	[Quarter] AS [Quarter],
	[Year] AS [Year],
	[WeekNumber] AS [WeekNumber],
	[DayOfWeek] AS [DayOfWeek],
	[IsWeekend] AS [IsWeekend],
	[HalfYear] AS [HalfYear];
SQL SELECT  `DateKey`,
	 `Date`,
	 `Day`,
	 `Month`,
	 `MonthName`,
	 `Quarter`,
	 `Year`,
	 `WeekNumber`,
	 `DayOfWeek`,
	 `IsWeekend`,
	 `HalfYear`
FROM `turbobi`.`test`.`dim_date`;
